```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# This child template expects the following variables in the environment:
# - sig_data: List from compute_signature_data()
# - plot_paths: List of paths to pre-generated plot files

cat(generate_section_header(sig_data))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

displayplot = function(mypath, wid = getp('hw')) {
  cat(paste0("<img src=\"", mypath, "\" style=\"width: ", wid, ";\" />"))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# ID89 plots: signature and catalog (stacked vertically)
cat('<div style="margin-bottom: 10px;">\n')
displayplot(plot_paths$id89_sig, getp("hw89"))
cat('</div>\n')

cat('<div style="margin-bottom: 10px;">\n')
displayplot(plot_paths$id89_catalog, getp("hw89"))
cat('</div>\n')
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Decomposition plots (only for non-InsDel15/16)
if (!is.null(plot_paths$id89_reconstructed) && !is.null(plot_paths$id89_diff)) {
  cat('<div style="display: gap: 3px; margin-bottom: 6px;">\n')
  displayplot(plot_paths$id89_reconstructed, getp("hw89"))
  # cat("</div>\n")

  # cat('<div style="display: flex; gap: 3px; margin-bottom: 6px;">\n')
  displayplot(plot_paths$id89_diff, getp("hw89"))
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# 476-type section header
if (sig_data$has_476_signature) {
  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="signature-subtitle">',
    "476-type representation corresponding to ",
    sig_data$ID89signature,
    '</div>\n\n'
  ))
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<p>Cosine similarity between 476-type signature and the spectrum of the supporting tumor: ',
    '<span class="cosine-value">',
    sig_data$cosine476,
    '</span></p>\n\n'
  ))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<div class="signature-note">',
    '476-Type ',
    sig_data$ID89signature,
    ' was not found by de novo extraction. ',
    'This is the 476-Type spectrum of ',
    sig_data$catalog,
    '</div>\n\n'
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# ID476 signature plot
if (!is.null(plot_paths$id476_sig)) {
  displayplot(plot_paths$id476_sig)
}
```

```{r}

  displayplot(plot_paths$id476_catalog)
}
```

```{r}

if (sig_data$has_83_signature) {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<div class="signature-subtitle">',
    "83-type signature corresponding to ",
    sig_data$ID89signature,
    " is ",
    sig_data$ID83signature,
    '</strong>',
    '</div>\n\n'
  ))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<div class="signature-note">',
    'No corresponding 83-type signature found for ',
    sig_data$ID89signature,
    '</div>\n\n'
  ))
}
```
